record_scope_reconstruction: May 29 2024 interruption of northbound traffic at the Pharr–Reynosa road bridge. Reporter accounts disagree on duration and whether protesters or federal officials physically closed passage.

source_checks.finding: KRGV May 30 original identifies previous Wednesday, northbound circulation and resumption about17:30, while describing a closure of minutes.
Excélsior May29 original attributes closure to federal/SAT officials before14:00 and reopening nearly three hours later; retain conflict.
Original OEM page returned403; no fresh full-text verification claimed.
